lines.text: David says his soul finds rest in God alone, who is his rock, salvation and fortress.
David asks how long they will threaten a man like a leaning wall, as they delight in lies.
David tells his soul to rest in God alone, because his victory comes from Him.
David tells the people to trust God at all times and not to trust extortion or stolen goods.
God has spoken once, and David heard twice that power belongs to God, who repays each man according to his birth.
